exercises.question: I cannot ___ to buy a new laptop this month, so I will continue using my old one.
exercises.explanation: **Afford** means have enough money to pay for something.

exercises.question: It is important to ___ a budget so you do not overspend.
exercises.explanation: “Create a budget” means to plan your spending.

exercises.question: Customers can often ___ a refund if the product is faulty.
exercises.explanation: “Request a refund” means to ask for your money back.

exercises.question: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence: Prices have _______ sharply this year.
